name: MarkuClean Markup Cleaner
author: Ivijan-Stefan Stipic

sections.description:
MarkuClean Markup Cleaner is a lightweight and safe WordPress plugin designed to clean unwanted HTML artifacts generated by AI tools such as ChatGPT.

Modern AI tools often inject technical markup into copied content, including attributes like:

  • data-start=”123″
  • data-end=”456″
  • <hr data-start="…" data-end="…" />
  • UI markers from AI interfaces

These attributes are not part of WordPress logic and can pollute your HTML, create spacing issues, or introduce unnecessary clutter into your content.

This plugin removes only those AI-specific artifacts while preserving:

  • Gutenberg block structure
  • WordPress block comments (<!-- wp: -->)
  • Elementor data attributes
  • Other builder-related data-* attributes
  • Core WordPress formatting

It is designed to be safe, minimal and non-destructive.

Features

  • Removes data-start and data-end attributes (numeric only)
  • Removes entire <hr> tags generated by AI (only when both data-start and data-end are present)
  • Cleans AI artifacts on paste
  • Cleans content on save (supports Gutenberg and TinyMCE)
  • Preserves all legitimate WordPress and builder markup
  • Compatible with Gutenberg, Classic Editor and Elementor
  • No heavy DOM rewriting
  • No interference with WordPress core logic

How It Works

The plugin hooks into the WordPress content save pipeline and:

  1. Unsplashes post content properly.
  2. Removes only AI-specific attributes using strict matching rules.
  3. Re-applies proper slashing before WordPress saves content.
  4. Leaves all other attributes untouched.

It also handles escaped attributes such as:

data-start=\”123\”

to ensure cleaning works in real WordPress save scenarios.

The plugin never modifies:

  • Custom data-* attributes used by builders
  • JSON block attributes
  • Elementor internal metadata
  • WordPress block comments
  • Post meta unrelated to content

Usage

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Paste AI-generated content into Gutenberg or Classic Editor.
  3. Click Update / Publish.
  4. AI-specific attributes will be automatically removed.
  5. Your formatting and builder structure will remain intact.

No configuration is required.

Supported Editors

  • Gutenberg (Block Editor)
  • Classic Editor (TinyMCE)
  • Elementor (post_content cleaning safe)
  • Any editor that saves content via standard WordPress pipeline

Example Cleanup

Before:

`<p data-start="74" data-end="116">Text...</p>

“`

After:

<p>Text...</p><h3>Performance</h3>

The plugin uses targeted regex and minimal processing.
It does not load unnecessary libraries.
It does not run heavy DOM rewrites unless required.
Impact on performance is negligible.

Security

The plugin:

  • Does not store external data
  • Does not send data outside WordPress
  • Does not modify user roles or permissions
  • Only filters content during save

Author

Developed by ivijanstefan

License

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate through the WordPress admin panel
  3. Done.
sections.faq:
Will this break Gutenberg?

No. The plugin does not touch block comments or block JSON attributes.

Will this break Elementor?

No. Elementor data attributes remain untouched. Only AI-specific numeric data-start and data-end attributes are removed.

Does it remove all data-* attributes?

No. Only data-start and data-end when numeric.

Can I disable save cleanup?

Yes, if the plugin version includes the advanced option in settings.
